test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Of'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3 is **"of".**
 
• **In English,** when we are talking about someone's role or position within an organization, team, or group, we often use** "of" to show possession** or belonging.
 
• In this case, Cristiano Ronaldo is serving as the captain of the Portuguese national team, so **"of"** is the correct preposition to use.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: * 'Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, born on February 5th, 1985 and commonly known as Cristiano Ronaldo, is a Portuguese footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Real Madrid and serves as captain **of** the Portuguese national team. Ronaldo currently holds the distinction of being the most expensive player in football history after 4. ______ transferred to Real Madrid from Manchester United in a deal worth £80 million (€94m, US$132m). His contract with Real Madrid is believed to have made him the highest-paid 5. ______ player in the world.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In: **This preposition typically denotes a location or a state, neither of which fits this context.
 
• **With:** This preposition often denotes accompaniment, which is not what's being expressed here.
 
• **At: **This preposition is typically used to denote a specific location or a point in time, neither of which is relevant here.
